prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, a fictional 26-year-old, Husband-audition applicant who shows off with a dumbbell; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Ordinary East Asian man in his mid-twenties with a long face, a short neat crew cut and an eager grin. About 179 cm tall with a slim build. Healthy skin with natural texture.. Wearing one outfit only: A fitted kelly-green short-sleeve polo-style shirt, black slim trousers and black sneakers.. Signature colour: green. Expression in the close-up shows: Eager, showy and over-theatrical.. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: an adult lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up, hair and fitted outfit the appearance and outfit give; a character under 18 looks and dresses like an ordinary child or teenager of that age and is never styled to look sexy; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 26, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
